title: Titanium Wheel Hub Pawl Spring
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Wheel Hub Pawl Spring because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of Hub ratchet pawl leaf spring (Nitinol). This rationale is driven by hub ratchet pawl leaf spring (nitinol) and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for wheel hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g for net-shape tolerance
Go/No-Go ring gauging for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for hub ratchet pawl application
commonFailures: Thread galling Ti-on-Ti assembly - prevented by MoS2 anti-seize compound and -20% installation torque — critical for hub ratchet pawl performance

faq.q: How much weight savings does Titanium Wheel Hub Pawl Spring offer versus steel or aluminum?
faq.a: Titanium Wheel Hub Pawl Spring fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides a 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130 chromoly steel (4.43 vs 7.85 g/cm³) at the same strength. Compared to 6061-T6 aluminum, titanium's 3× higher yield strength (830 vs 275 MPa) allows 50-60% thinner walls, resulting in a net weight comparable to aluminum with 4× better fatigue life — critical for hub ratchet pawl.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Wheel Hub Pawl Spring?
faq.a: Each Titanium Wheel Hub Pawl Spring shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for hub ratchet pawl.
